title: Direct Uttarakhand CM to register FIR against those behind ‘purification’ of Haldwani rally site, Kharge writes to Nadda
description: The act amounts to the practice of untouchability, Congress chief says, adding that he will approach Rajya Sabha Chairman over the issue; ‘Even after 24 days of this incident, not even an FIR has been filed against the organisations and individuals involved in this heinous act,’ the Congress leader says
